blocks.zh: 第五節：設備
blocks.en: Section 5: Equipment

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解無菌製造設備設計的基本要求，包括文件化與初始確效套件的關聯
blocks.en: Understand the basic requirements for sterile manufacturing equipment design, including documentation and its link to the initial qualification package

blocks.zh: 區分直接接觸產品零件 (direct product contact parts) 與間接接觸零件 (indirect product contact parts) 之滅菌要求
blocks.en: Distinguish the sterilisation requirements for direct product contact parts from those for indirect product contact parts

blocks.zh: 掌握設備警報管理、計畫性與非計畫性維護的 GMP 要求
blocks.en: Understand the GMP requirements for equipment alarm management and for planned and unplanned maintenance

blocks.zh: 理解傳送帶跨潔淨室等級的限制，以及粒子計數器取樣管的資格要求
blocks.en: Understand the restriction on conveyors passing between cleanroom grades, and the qualification requirements for particle counter sampling tubing

blocks.zh: 5.1–5.2 設備設計文件與警報管理 Equipment Documentation & Alarm Management
blocks.en: 5.1–5.2 Equipment Documentation & Alarm Management

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: User Requirements Specification (URS，使用者需求規格書)：設備採購前最重要的文件，定義設備必須達到的功能、效能與 GMP 需求。URS 是後續設計確效 (DQ)、安裝確效 (IQ)、操作確效 (OQ)、性能確效 (PQ) 的源頭基礎。
blocks.en: User Requirements Specification (URS): the most important document before equipment is purchased. It defines the functions, performance and GMP requirements the equipment must meet. The URS is the foundation for the subsequent design qualification (DQ), installation qualification (IQ), operational qualification (OQ) and performance qualification (PQ).

blocks.zh: Process and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID，製程與儀表圖)：顯示管線流向、感測器位置、閥門類型等工程細節的技術圖面，是設備確效套件的核心文件之一。
blocks.en: Process and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID): a technical drawing showing engineering details such as piping flow, sensor locations and valve types. It is one of the core documents in the equipment qualification package.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 設備設計文件就像一棟建築的「建築圖與竣工圖」——不只建造時需要，之後每次維修、改建都要對照原圖。若圖紙未保持最新，維護人員就像在黑暗中摸索，容易造成錯誤。PIC/S 要求「kept up to date」正是這個道理：每次變更都必須同步更新圖面文件。
blocks.en: Equipment design documentation is like a building's architectural and as-built drawings: they are needed not only during construction, but for every later repair or renovation. If the drawings are not kept current, maintenance staff are working in the dark and errors are likely. This is exactly why PIC/S requires them to be "kept up to date": every change must be reflected in the drawings and documents.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 警報管理 (Alarm Management) 是近年 FDA 483 觀察項目的高頻主題。關鍵點：
blocks.en: Alarm management has been a frequent topic in FDA 483 observations in recent years. The key points:

blocks.zh: 警報必須被「確認 (acknowledged)」，不能被忽視或靜音
blocks.en: Alarms must be acknowledged; they cannot be ignored or silenced

blocks.zh: 必須「評估趨勢 (evaluated for trends)」，單次警報與系統性惡化意義完全不同
blocks.en: They must be evaluated for trends; a single alarm means something very different from systematic deterioration

blocks.zh: 關鍵警報 (critical alarms) 必須立即審核——這是對製程異常即時響應的基本要求
blocks.en: Critical alarms must be reviewed immediately; this is a basic requirement for responding in real time to process abnormalities

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 當設備的一個非關鍵 (non-critical) 溫度警報在一個月內發生了 15 次，你應該如何處理？這和「關鍵警報」的處理有何不同？
blocks.en: A non-critical temperature alarm on a piece of equipment occurred 15 times in one month. How should you handle it? How does this differ from handling a critical alarm?

blocks.zh: URS 應在何時撰寫？若設備已購買後才補寫 URS，這在監管角度上代表什麼問題？
blocks.en: When should the URS be written? If the URS is written only after the equipment has already been purchased, what does that signal from a regulatory perspective?

blocks.zh: 5.3–5.4 維護管理與清潔驗證 Maintenance & Cleaning Validation
blocks.en: 5.3–5.4 Maintenance & Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: 維護於潔淨室外設計原則：這是 CCS（污染控制策略）中「設計排除污染源」的體現。理想設計是設備的馬達、驅動系統、電控箱等維護密集的零件穿牆安裝，服務側在C/D級或普通區，只有無菌接觸面在A/B級。
blocks.en: Design principle of maintenance outside the cleanroom: this reflects "designing out contamination sources" in the CCS (contamination control strategy). The ideal design places maintenance-intensive parts such as motors, drive systems and electrical control boxes through the wall, with the service side in a grade C/D or unclassified area and only the sterile contact surfaces in grade A/B.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證 (Cleaning Validation)：滅菌前必須先清潔。殘留有機物、顆粒或蛋白質會「保護」微生物，使消毒劑無法有效作用（即「有機物干擾效應」）。因此清潔是消毒/滅菌有效性的前提。
blocks.en: Cleaning validation: cleaning must be done before sterilisation. Residual organic matter, particles or proteins can "protect" microorganisms and prevent the disinfectant from acting effectively (the "organic load interference effect"). Cleaning is therefore a prerequisite for effective disinfection/sterilisation.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室維護就像「在手術室中修理設備」——理想上你不希望工人帶著工具箱走進手術室。若真的必須進入，就要有嚴格的穿著、行為協議，以及事後的清潔消毒確認。設計設備時就要思考這個問題：如何讓維護工作盡量在「手術室外」完成？
blocks.en: Cleanroom maintenance is like "repairing equipment in an operating theatre": ideally you do not want workers walking in with a toolbox. If entry is unavoidable, strict gowning and behaviour protocols are required, plus confirmation of cleaning and disinfection afterwards. Think about this at the equipment design stage: how can maintenance be done outside the "operating theatre" as far as possible?

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證的兩個核心目的要牢記：
blocks.en: Keep in mind the two core purposes of cleaning validation:

blocks.zh: 目的一：確保消毒劑能有效作用（殘留物不干擾消毒）
blocks.en: Purpose 1: ensure the disinfectant can work effectively (residues do not interfere with disinfection)

blocks.zh: 目的二：最小化消毒前的微生物與顆粒污染
blocks.en: Purpose 2: minimise microbial and particulate contamination before disinfection

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，多產品共用設備時清潔驗證更為複雜，必須考慮「最難清潔的產品 (worst case product)」作為驗證基準。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, cleaning validation is more complex when multiple products share equipment, and the "worst case product" (the hardest to clean) must be used as the validation basis.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 業務中，當客戶要求在同一條填充線生產多個產品時，清潔驗證策略直接影響產能排程。若清潔驗證只針對一個產品，引入新產品時需要重新驗證，可能導致數週的生產空窗期。建議在 CDMO 報價階段就評估清潔驗證的範疇，避免後期延誤。
blocks.en: In CDMO business, when a client asks to produce several products on the same filling line, the cleaning validation strategy directly affects production scheduling. If cleaning validation covers only one product, introducing a new product requires revalidation, which can mean a production gap of several weeks. It is advisable to assess the scope of cleaning validation at the CDMO quotation stage to avoid delays later.

blocks.zh: 若維護人員必須在 Grade B 區進行緊急修繕，完成後應採取哪些額外的 GMP 措施？
blocks.en: If maintenance staff must carry out an emergency repair in a grade B area, what additional GMP measures should be taken after completion?

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證與清潔確認 (cleaning verification) 有何差異？在實際生產中各自何時使用？
blocks.en: What is the difference between cleaning validation and cleaning verification? When is each used in actual production?

blocks.zh: 5.5–5.7 滅菌要求與設備確效 Sterilisation Requirements & Equipment Qualification
blocks.en: 5.5–5.7 Sterilisation Requirements & Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 直接接觸零件 (Direct Product Contact Parts)：產品流經的路徑，如充填針頭、泵浦、管線、軟管、過濾器。這些零件的滅菌是無菌保證的「最後一道防線」，失效則直接危害患者。
blocks.en: Direct Product Contact Parts: the path the product flows through, such as filling needles, pumps, piping, hoses and filters. Sterilisation of these parts is the "last line of defence" for sterility assurance; failure directly endangers patients.

blocks.zh: 間接接觸零件 (Indirect Product Contact Parts)：不直接碰觸產品，但可能接觸其他已滅菌表面，如塞子碗 (stopper bowl) 的導軌。若導軌未滅菌，已滅菌的塞子與導軌接觸後可能被污染——這是一種「逆向污染路徑」，容易被忽略。
blocks.en: Indirect Product Contact Parts: parts that do not touch the product directly but may contact other sterilised surfaces, such as the guide rails of a stopper bowl. If the rails are not sterilised, sterilised stoppers can be contaminated when they touch them. This is a "reverse contamination path" that is easily overlooked.

blocks.zh: 想像手術器械的滅菌：不只是手術刀（直接接觸患者）需要滅菌，放置手術刀的器械盤、傳遞夾（間接接觸手術刀的表面）也必須滅菌。若器械盤未滅菌，放上去的無菌手術刀立刻被污染——PIC/S 5.5 的邏輯與此完全一致。
blocks.en: Think of sterilising surgical instruments: it is not only the scalpel (which touches the patient directly) that must be sterile, but also the instrument tray and transfer forceps on which the scalpel rests (surfaces in indirect contact with it). If the tray is not sterile, a sterile scalpel placed on it is contaminated immediately. The logic of PIC/S 5.5 is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 非計畫性維護 (Unplanned Maintenance) 的影響評估是關鍵合規點：
blocks.en: Impact assessment of unplanned maintenance is a key compliance point:

blocks.zh: 維護完成後必須有正式的「恢復使用批准 (return to use approval)」程序
blocks.en: After maintenance there must be a formal "return to use approval" procedure

blocks.zh: 非計畫性維護必須進行無菌影響評估並記錄——這代表即使緊急維修，也必須事後補做風險評估文件
blocks.en: Unplanned maintenance must be assessed for its impact on sterility and the assessment documented; even for an emergency repair, the risk assessment documentation must be completed afterwards

blocks.zh: 滅菌設備（如滅菌釜）、空調系統、水系統，任何一個維護後未經批准就恢復使用，都是重大的 GMP 偏差
blocks.en: For sterilising equipment (such as autoclaves), HVAC systems and water systems, returning any of them to use after maintenance without approval is a major GMP deviation

blocks.zh: 充填機的泵浦（直接接觸零件）進行了緊急維修後，需要哪些步驟才能恢復生產？
blocks.en: After an emergency repair of a filling machine pump (a direct contact part), what steps are needed before production can resume?

blocks.zh: 塞子碗導軌屬於直接還是間接接觸零件？這個分類如何影響它的清潔與滅菌要求？
blocks.en: Is a stopper bowl guide rail a direct or an indirect contact part? How does this classification affect its cleaning and sterilisation requirements?

blocks.zh: 5.8–5.9 傳送帶限制與粒子計數器確效 Conveyor Restrictions & Particle Counter Qualification
blocks.en: 5.8–5.9 Conveyor Restrictions & Particle Counter Qualification

blocks.zh: 傳送帶跨等級限制：傳送帶是一個「移動的污染載體」——帶子從低潔淨區帶進的微粒、微生物，會直接進入 Grade A/B。唯一例外是帶子本身持續滅菌（例如通過高溫滅菌隧道），將污染在越過隔牆前消滅。
blocks.en: Restriction on conveyors crossing grades: a conveyor is a "moving carrier of contamination": particles and microorganisms carried on the belt from a lower grade area would go directly into grade A/B. The only exception is where the belt itself is continuously sterilised (for example by passing through a hot-air sterilising tunnel), destroying the contamination before it crosses the dividing wall.

blocks.zh: 等速取樣頭 (Isokinetic Sampling Head)：在單向氣流 (Unidirectional Airflow, UDAF) 系統中，取樣頭的方向必須對準氣流方向，且進氣流速必須等於環境氣流速，才能確保取樣具代表性。若取樣頭方向錯誤或流速不匹配，計數結果可能嚴重失真。
blocks.en: Isokinetic Sampling Head: in a unidirectional airflow (UDAF) system, the sampling head must face into the airflow, and the intake velocity must equal the ambient air velocity, to ensure the sample is representative. If the head is oriented wrongly or the velocity does not match, the count result can be seriously distorted.

blocks.zh: 粒子計數器取樣管就像「聽診器的導管」——導管太長、彎太多，聲音（粒子訊號）就會在傳導中衰減或失真。PIC/S 規定管長不超過 1 公尺、最小化彎道，正是確保「聽到的就是真實的訊號」，而不是因傳輸損失造成的假陰性結果。
blocks.en: A particle counter sampling tube is like the "tubing of a stethoscope": if the tube is too long or has too many bends, the sound (the particle signal) is attenuated or distorted in transmission. PIC/S limits tube length to no more than 1 metre and requires bends to be minimised, precisely so that what you "hear" is the true signal and not a false negative caused by transmission loss.

blocks.zh: 粒子計數器確效是環境監測計畫 (Environmental Monitoring Program) 可靠性的基礎。常見的合規問題：
blocks.en: Particle counter qualification is the foundation for the reliability of the environmental monitoring program. Common compliance issues:

blocks.zh: 取樣管未納入確效範疇（只確效計數器本體）
blocks.en: Sampling tubing not included in the qualification scope (only the counter itself is qualified)

blocks.zh: UDAF 區域未使用等速取樣頭
blocks.en: Isokinetic sampling heads not used in UDAF areas

blocks.zh: 便攜式計數器用於等級認定 (classification) 時，取樣管長度超過規定
blocks.en: Tubing length exceeding the specified limit when portable counters are used for classification

blocks.zh: 計數器校正頻率不足或紀錄不完整
blocks.en: Insufficient calibration frequency or incomplete records for counters

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 廠房設計階段，若客戶要求 Grade A 充填區連接到 Grade C 傳送出料區，工程師必須在設計階段就解決傳送帶跨等級問題。可行方案包括：(1) 在傳送帶穿牆處設置高溫滅菌隧道；(2) 改用 RTP（快速傳遞口）進行批量傳遞；(3) 重新佈局生產線，使充填後產品在 Grade A 隔離器內完成初步處理再傳出。每種方案有不同的成本與驗證要求。
blocks.en: At the CDMO facility design stage, if a client asks for a grade A filling area to be connected to a grade C conveyor discharge area, engineers must resolve the conveyor grade-crossing problem during design. Feasible options include: (1) installing a hot-air sterilising tunnel where the conveyor passes through the wall; (2) switching to an RTP (rapid transfer port) for batch transfer; (3) re-laying out the line so that filled product is initially handled inside a grade A isolator before being transferred out. Each option has different cost and validation requirements.

blocks.zh: 為何在單向氣流系統中使用非等速取樣頭會導致粒子計數結果偏低？這對無菌保證有何影響？
blocks.en: Why does using a non-isokinetic sampling head in a unidirectional airflow system give low particle count results? What does this mean for sterility assurance?

blocks.zh: 一條傳送帶從 Grade B 延伸至 Grade C，需要哪些補救措施？若無法安裝滅菌隧道，有什麼替代方案？
blocks.en: A conveyor extends from grade B to grade C. What corrective measures are needed? If a sterilising tunnel cannot be installed, what alternatives are there?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 設備設計文件（含 P&ID）必須形成初始確效套件的一部分，並持續保持最新；URS 在開發早期定義監測要求，確效過程中確認。
blocks.en: Equipment design documentation (including the P&ID) must form part of the initial qualification package and be kept up to date; the URS defines monitoring requirements early in development and is confirmed during qualification.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室外維護為設計原則；若必須在潔淨室內維護，需有額外清潔、消毒與環境監測；非計畫性維護必須評估對無菌性的潛在影響並記錄。
blocks.en: Maintenance outside the cleanroom is the design principle; where maintenance must take place inside the cleanroom, additional cleaning, disinfection and environmental monitoring are required; unplanned maintenance must be assessed for its potential impact on sterility and documented.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程中，直接接觸零件（充填針頭、泵浦）與間接接觸零件（塞子碗導軌）均須滅菌；設備（包括滅菌釜、空調、水系統）維護後恢復使用前必須獲得批准。
blocks.en: In aseptic processing, both direct contact parts (filling needles, pumps) and indirect contact parts (stopper bowl guide rails) must be sterilised; equipment (including autoclaves, HVAC and water systems) must be approved before being returned to use after maintenance.

blocks.zh: 傳送帶不得在未持續滅菌情況下穿越 Grade A/B 與低等級區之間的隔牆；粒子計數器含取樣管皆需確效，UDAF 環境中必須使用等速取樣頭，管長原則上不超過 1 公尺。
blocks.en: Conveyors must not pass through the dividing wall between grade A/B and lower grade areas unless they are continuously sterilised; particle counters, including their sampling tubing, must be qualified; isokinetic sampling heads must be used in UDAF environments, and tubing length should in principle not exceed 1 metre.
